questions.q_en: In a relief camp there are 100 people and 1500 kg of grain is sufficient for them for 25 days. After 10 days 50 more man came in the camp for shelter. If now all the people have reduced their daily consumption of food by 1/4th then how many days food will last in the camp?
questions.solution_en:
Amount of grain remaining in the camp after

10 days = [1500 - (10/25 X 1500)] kg

=900 kg

Daily consumption of grain by one man = 1500/((100 X 25))=3/5 kg

Now total consumption of grain by 150 people

in one day = (150 X 3/5 X 3/4) kg

Let's assume that now remaining grain will last for 'd' days;

Hence; 150 X 3/5 X 3/4 X d=900

=> d= (13) (1/3) Days

questions.q_en: A work can be completed by 40 workers in 40 days. If 5 workers leave every 10 days then in how many days work will be completed?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = (40 X 40) = 1600 man - days = 1600 MD

Total work done in first 10 days = (10 X 40) = 400 MD

Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 35) = 350 MD

Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 30) = 300 MD

Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 25) = 250 MD

Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 20) = 200 MD

Total work done after 50 days = (400 + 350 + 300 + 250 + 200)

= 1500 MD

Remaining work = (1600 - 1500) MD = 100 MD

Now number of people still working = 15

Number of days taken to finish the remaining work = 100/15 = (6) (2/3) days

So total number of days taken to complete the work = (50 + (6) (2/3)) days

= (56) (2/3) days

questions.q_en: Worker A alone worked for 24 days in Rs. X and worker B alone worked for 36 days in Rs. X. For how many days Rs. X is sufficient to pay A and B together?
questions.solution_en:
Let amount of money = LCM (24, 36) = Rs.72

Money charged by worker A per day = 72/24 = Rs.3 per day

Money charged by worked B per day = 72/36 = Rs.2 per day

When they work together, charges per day = Rs.5 per day

So, required number of days = 72/5 = 14(2/5) days

questions.q_en: A can do a piece of work in 18 days. B and C together can do the same piece of work in 12 days. If the efficiency of A is 10/9th the efficiency of B, then find the time taken by C to do the same piece of work.
questions.solution_en:
Total work = L.C.M of 18 and 12 = 36

Efficiency = Total work/ Time taken

Efficiency of A = 36/18 = 2

Efficiency of B and C = 36/12 = 3

Efficiency of B = Efficiency of A * 9/10 = 2 * 9/10 = 1.8

Efficiency of C = 3 - 1.8 = 1.2

Hence, the time taken by C to do the same piece of work = 36/1.2 = 30 days

questions.q_en: Achinta, Bobby, Cindrella working together completed a job in 10 days. However, Cindrella only worked for the first three days when 0.37 part of the job was done. Also, the work done by Achinta in 5 days is equal to the work done by Bobby in four days. How many days would be required by the fastest worker to complete the entire work?
questions.solution_en:
The equations are:

3 (A + B + C) = 37% of the work.

7 (A + B) = 63% of the work.

So, A + B = 9% of the work --- (1)

Where A, B, C are one day's work of Achinta, Bobby and Cindrella respectively.

Further 5A = 4B --- (2)

From (1) and (2), A = 4% of the work and B = 5% of the work

In 3 days (A + B + C) do 37% of the work.

Out of that, A + B do 9% each day.

Hence, in three days, (A + B) X 3 = 27% of the work.

Remaining work in first three days = 37 - 27 = 10% of the work

So, Cindrella would do 3.33% of the work in a day.

Thus Bobby is the fastest and he would complete it in 20 days.

questions.q_en: Prakash's 5 day's work is equal to Suresh's 3 day's work and ratio of efficiency of Suresh to Krishna is 4: 3. Suresh and Krishna started working together and worked for 4 days. After that Krishna left the work and Prakash joined Suresh and they together worked for next 5 days. Now Suresh left the work and Prakash alone finished the remaining work in 5 more day. Find that in how many days Suresh can finish the work alone?
questions.solution_en:
Prakash's 5 day's work is equal to Suresh's 3 day's work. So ratio of their efficiency = 1/5 ∶1/3 = 3 : 5

Ratio of efficiency of Suresh to Krishna = 4 : 3

The ratio of efficiency of Prakash, Suresh and Krishna = 12 : 20 : 15

Let 1 day of work of Prakash, Suresh and Krishan is 12x, 20x and 15x respectively.

Total work = (20x + 15x) * 4 + (12x + 20x) * 5 + 12x * 5 = 360x

Time taken by Suresh alone to finish the work = 360x/20x = 18 days

questions.q_en: Ritika alone can paint (4/5)th part of a house in 48 hours while Ravi can paint 1/3rd part of the house in 25 hours. If Ravi start painting the house and on every third hour Ritika joined him, then the house will be painted in -
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Ritika alone to paint = 48 * 5/4 = 60 hours

Time taken by Ravi alone to paint = 25 * 3/1 = 75 hours

Since, Ravi start painting the house and on every third hour Ritika joined him. Then,

First two hours work done by Ravi alone = 2/75

Third hour's work done by Ravi and Ritika together = 1/75 + 1/60 = 3/100

Then, first 3 hours work done = 2/75 + 3/100 = 17/300

Therefore, part of work done in (3 * 17 = 51) hours = 17 * 17/300 = 289/300

Remaining work = 1 - 289/300 = 11/300

Now, part of work done by Ravi in next two hours (i.e., 52nd and 53rd hour) = 2/75

Then, remaining work = 11/300 - 2/75 = 1/100

Now, time taken by Ravi and Ritika together to do remaining work = (1/100) * 100/3 = 1/3 hours = 1/3 * 60 = 20 minutes

Therefore, total time taken = 51 hours + 2 hours + 20 minutes

= 53 hours 20 minutes

questions.q_en: Jiya, Riya, and Kiya took a work in Rs. 1848 and completed it together in 15 days. If Riya is 75% more efficient than Kiya and Kiya and Jiya together can complete the same work in 40 days, then what is the difference between the share of Jiya and Kiya?
questions.solution_en:
Riya alone can complete the whole work in = 1/(1/15 - 1/40) = 24 days

So, Kiya alone can complete the whole work in = 24 * 175/100 = 42 days

And Jiya alone can complete the whole work in = 1/(1/40 - 1/42) = 840 days

Ratio of efficiency of Jiya, Riya, and Kiya = 1/840: 1/24: 1/42 = 1: 35: 20

Hence, difference between the share of Jiya and Kiya = (20 - 1)/(1 + 35 + 20) * 1848 = (19/ 56)* 1848 = 19 * 33 = Rs. 627

Ratio of their work done = (1/3): (1/4): (5/12) = 4: 3: 5

Share of B = 5250 * (3/12) = Rs.1312.5

questions.q_en: A can do 4/5th of the work in 48 hours, B can do half of the work in 20 hours while C can do 33(1/3)% of the work in 10 hours. All of them started the work together, A and B left 6 hours and 4 hours before the completion of the work respectively. Find the total time taken to complete the work.
questions.solution_en:
33(1/3) means (33 + 1/3) od (100/3).

A = 48 * 5/4 = 60 hours

B = 20 * 2 = 40 hours

C = 10 * 100/(100/3) = 30 hours

A and B left 6 hours and 4 hours before the completion of the work respectively. This means C alone worked for last 4 hours while B and C together worked for 2 hours before that time. So,

Part of work done by C in 4 hours = 4/30 = 2/15

Part of work done by B and C together in 2 hours = 2 * (1/30 + 1/40) = 7/60

So, remaining work (which is done by A, B and C together) = 1 - 2/15 - 7/60 = 3/4

Let A, B and C together completed 3/4 part of the work in t hours. Now,

t = (3/4) * 1/(1/60 + 1/40 + 1/30)

t = (3/4) * 120/9

t = 10

Therefore, total time taken to complete the work = 10 + 2 + 4 = 16 hours

questions.q_en: If A can complete the task in 5 days, B can complete the task in 6 days and C can complete the task in 7 days, then what is the difference in the amount paid to B and A, if all work together and are paid Rs.5350 in total?
questions.solution_en:
Easier method of finding the share of the total price is as follows:

A's share∶B's share∶C's share=6 X 7∶7 X 5∶5 X 6

A's share∶B's share∶C's share=42∶35∶30

A's share=5350/(42+35+30) X 42=224700/107=Rs.2100

Bs share=5350/(42+35+30) X 35=224700/107=Rs.1750

Difference in the share of A and B = 2100-1750= Rs.350

questions.q_en: A can do a piece of work in 30 days, B in 50 days and C in 40 days. If A is assisted by B on one day and by C on the next day alternately, the work will be completed in:
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 30, 50, and 40 = 600

A's one day work = 600/30 = 20

B's one day work = 600/50 = 12

C's one day work = 600/40 = 15

Total one day work when A and B together works = 20 + 12 = 32

Total one day work when A and C together works = 20 + 15 = 35

Total 2 days work = 32 + 35 = 67

Total work in 16 days = (67/2) * 16 = 536

Total work in 17 days = 536 + 32 = 568

Remaining work = 600 - 568 = 32

Hence, total time taken to finish the work = 17 + (32/35) = 17(32/35) days

questions.q_en: 25 men completely build a wall working for 40 days. After working for 24 days 35 more men joined the workers. Now remaining portion of the wall will be built in how many days?
questions.solution_en:
According to the question 25 men can complete the work in 40 days hence amount of work done by 1 man in one day = 1/((25 X 40) )=1/1000

Total amount of work done in 24 days = (25 X 24)/1000=3/5

Now remaining work = 1- 3/5=2/5

Now total number of people working to build a wall = (25 + 35) = 60

Let's suppose they will take 'N' days to complete the remaining work. Therefore: 1/1000 X 60 X N=2/5

=> N=(2 X 1000)/(5 X 60)

=> N=6 2/3 Days

So, remaining work will be completed in 6(2/3) Days.
